effects.may: Have this creature fight Grothama, All-Devouring?

grants.text: Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it fight Grothama, All-Devouring.

abilities.text: Other creatures have "Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it fight Grothama, All-Devouring."
When Grothama leaves the battlefield, each player draws cards equal to the amount of damage dealt to Grothama this turn by sources they controlled.
